style="font-size:0.87em">"May"</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">context</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">"month name"</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><b>blocktranslate template tag</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>Contrarily to the <a href="index.html#page_660"><i>translate</i></a> tag, the blocktranslate tag allows you to mark complex sentences consisting of literals and variable content for translation by making use of placeholders:</p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>blocktranslate</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">This string will have</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{{</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">value</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>}}</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">inside.</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>endblocktranslate</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>To translate a template expression – say, accessing object attributes or using template filters – you need to bind the expression to a local variable for use within the translation block. Examples:</p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>blocktranslate with</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">amount</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">article.price</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">That will cost $</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{{</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">amount</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>}}</b></i></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>endblocktranslate</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>blocktranslate with</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">myvar</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">value</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>|</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>filter</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">This will have</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{{</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">myvar</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>}}</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">inside.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>endblocktranslate</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>You can use multiple expressions inside a single blocktranslate tag:</p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>blocktranslate with</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">book_t</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">book</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>|</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>title</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">author_t</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">author</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>|</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>title</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">This is</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{{</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">book_t</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>}}</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">by</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{{</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">author_t</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>}}</b></i></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>endblocktranslate</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p id="page_662"><b>Django Documentation, Release 5.2.dev20241127161328</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>Note: The previous more verbose format is still supported: {% blocktranslate with book|title as book_t and author|title as author_t %}</p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>Other block tags (for example <a href="index.html#page_1985"><i>{% for %}</i></a> or <a href="index.html#page_1986"><i>{% if %}</i></a>) are not allowed inside a blocktranslate tag.</p> <p>If resolving one of the block arguments fails, blocktranslate will fall back to the default language by de-</p> <p>activating the currently active language temporarily with the <a href="index.html#page_2090"><i>deactivate_all()</i></a> function.</p> <p>This tag also provides for pluralization. To use it:</p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• Designate and bind a counter value with the name count. This value will be the one used to select the</p> <p style="margin-left:2em">right plural form.</p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• Specify both the singular and plural forms separating them with the {% plural %} tag within the {%</p> <p style="margin-left:2em">blocktranslate %} and {% endblocktranslate %} tags.</p> <p>An example:</p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>blocktranslate</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">count counter</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">list</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>|</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>length</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">There is only one</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{{</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">name</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>}}</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">object.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>plural</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">There are</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{{</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">counter</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>}} {{</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">name</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>}}</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">objects.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>endblocktranslate</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>A more complex example:</p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>blocktranslate with</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">amount</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">article.price count years</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">i.length</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">That will cost $</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{{</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">amount</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>}}</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">per year.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>plural</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">That will cost $</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{{</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">amount</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>}}</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">per</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{{</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">years</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>}}</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">years.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>endblocktranslate</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>When you use both the pluralization feature and bind values to local variables in addition to the counter value, keep in mind that the blocktranslate construct is internally converted to an ngettext call. This</p> <p>means the same <a href="index.html#page_654">notes regarding ngettext variables</a> apply.</p> <p>Reverse URL lookups cannot be carried out within the blocktranslate and should be retrieved (and stored) beforehand:</p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>url</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">'path.to.view'</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">arg arg2</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>as</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">the_url</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>blocktranslate</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">This is a URL:</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{{</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">the_url</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>}}</b></i></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>endblocktranslate</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>If you’d like to retrieve a translated string without displaying it, you can use the following syntax:</p> <p id="page_663" style="text-align:right"><b>Django Documentation, Release 5.2.dev20241127161328</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>blocktranslate</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">asvar the_title</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">The title is</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{{</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">title</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>}}</b></i></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">.</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>endblocktranslate</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">title</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">></span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{{</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">the_title</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>}}</b></i></span><span style="font-size:0.87em"></</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">title</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">meta</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">name</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">"description"</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">content</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">"</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{{</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">the_title</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>}}</b></i></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">"</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">></span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>In practice you’ll use this to get a string you can use in multiple places in a template or so you can use the output as an argument for other template tags or filters.</p> <p>{% blocktranslate %} also supports <a href="index.html#page_654">contextual markers</a> using the context keyword:</p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>blocktranslate with</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">name</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">user.username context</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">"greeting"</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">Hi</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{{</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">name</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>}}{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>endblocktranslate</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>Another feature {% blocktranslate %} supports is the trimmed option. This option will remove newline characters from the beginning and the end of the content of the {% blocktranslate %} tag, replace any whitespace at the beginning and end of a line and merge all lines into one using a space character to separate them. This is quite useful for indenting the content of a {% blocktranslate %} tag without having the indentation characters end up in the corresponding entry in the .po file, which makes the translation process easier.</p> <p>For instance, the following {% blocktranslate %} tag:</p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>blocktranslate</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">trimmed</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p style="margin-left:1em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">First sentence.</span></p> <p style="margin-left:1em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">Second paragraph.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>endblocktranslate</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>will result in the entry "First sentence. Second paragraph." in the .po file, compared to "\n First sentence.\n Second paragraph.\n", if the trimmed option had not been specified.</p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><b>String literals passed to tags and filters</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>You can translate string literals passed as arguments to tags and filters by using the familiar _() syntax:</p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>some_tag _(</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">"Page not found"</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>)</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">value</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>|</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>yesno</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>:_(</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">"yes,no"</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>)</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>In this case, both the tag and the filter will see the translated string, so they don’t need to be aware of trans-lations.</p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>Note: In this example, the translation infrastructure will be passed the string "yes,no", not the individual strings "yes" and "no". The translated string will need to contain the comma so that the filter parsing code knows how to split up the arguments. For example, a German translator might translate the string "yes,no" as "ja,nein" (keeping the comma intact).</p> <p id="page_664"><b>Django Documentation, Release 5.2.dev20241127161328</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><b>Comments for translators in templates</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>Just like with <a href="index.html#page_652">Python code</a>, these notes for translators can be specified using comments, either with the</p> <p><a href="index.html#page_1980"><i>comment</i></a> tag:</p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>comment</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i>Translators: View verb</i></span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>endcomment</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>translate</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">"View"</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>comment</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i>Translators: Short intro blurb</i></span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>endcomment</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">p</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">></span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>blocktranslate</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">A multiline translatable</span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">literal.</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>endblocktranslate</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span><span style="font-size:0.87em"></</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">p</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">></span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>or with the {# <i>. . .</i> #} <a href="index.html#page_1970">one-line comment constructs</a><a href="index.html#page_1970">:</a></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i>{# Translators: Label of a button that triggers search #}</i></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">button</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">type</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">"submit"</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">></span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>translate</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">"Go"</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span><span style="font-size:0.87em"></</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">button</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">></span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i>{# Translators: This is a text of the base template #}</i></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>blocktranslate</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">Ambiguous translatable block of text</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>endblocktranslate</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>Note: Just for completeness, these are the corresponding fragments of the resulting .po file:</p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i>#. Translators: View verb</i></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i># path/to/template/file.html:10</i></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">msgid</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">"View"</span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">msgstr</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">""</span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i>#. Translators: Short intro blurb</i></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i># path/to/template/file.html:13</i></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">msgid</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">""</span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">"A multiline translatable"</span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">"literal."</span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">msgstr</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">""</span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i># ...</i></span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i>#. Translators: Label of a button that triggers search</i></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i># path/to/template/file.html:100</i></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">msgid</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">"Go"</span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">msgstr</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">""</span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i>#. Translators: This is a text of the base template</i></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i># path/to/template/file.html:103</i></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">msgid</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">"Ambiguous translatable block of text"</span></p> <p style="text-align:right"><span style="font-size:0.8em">(continues on next page)</span></p> <p id="page_665" style="text-align:right"><b>Django Documentation, Release 5.2.dev20241127161328</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p style="text-align:right"><span style="font-size:0.8em">(continued from previous page)</span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">msgstr</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">""</span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><b>Switching language in templates</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>If you want to select a language within a template, you can use the language template tag:</p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>load</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">i18n</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>get_current_language as</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">LANGUAGE_CODE</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><!-- Current language:</i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{{</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">LANGUAGE_CODE</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>}}</b></i></span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i>--></i></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">p</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">></span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>translate</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">"Welcome to our page"</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span><span style="font-size:0.87em"></</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">p</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">></span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>language</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">'en'</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>get_current_language as</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">LANGUAGE_CODE</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><!-- Current language:</i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{{</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">LANGUAGE_CODE</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>}}</b></i></span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i>--></i></span></p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em"><</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">p</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">></span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>translate</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">"Welcome to our page"</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span><span style="font-size:0.87em"></</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">p</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>endlanguage</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>While the first occurrence of “Welcome to our page” uses the current language, the second will always be in English.</p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><b>Other tags</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>These tags also require a {% load i18n %}.</p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><b>get_available_languages</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>{% get_available_languages as LANGUAGES %} returns a list of tuples in which the first element is the</p> <p><a href="index.html#page_706">language code</a> and the second is the language name (translated into the currently active locale).</p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><b>get_current_language</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>{% get_current_language as LANGUAGE_CODE %} returns the current user’s preferred language as a string.</p> <p>Example: en-us. See <a href="index.html#page_686">How Django discovers language preference.</a></p> <div style="page-break-after:always"></div> <p id="page_666"><b>Django Documentation, Release 5.2.dev20241127161328</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><b>get_current_language_bidi</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>{% get_current_language_bidi as LANGUAGE_BIDI %} returns the current locale’s direction. If True, it’s a right-to-left language, e.g. Hebrew, Arabic. If False it’s a left-to-right language, e.g. English, French, German, etc.</p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><b>i18n context processor</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>If you enable the <a href="index.html#page_2044"><i>django.template.context_processors.i18n</i></a> context processor, then each RequestContext will have access to LANGUAGES, LANGUAGE_CODE, and LANGUAGE_BIDI as defined above.</p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><b>get_language_info</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>You can also retrieve information about any of the available languages using provided template tags and filters. To get information about a single language, use the {% get_language_info %} tag:</p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>get_language_info</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">for LANGUAGE_CODE</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>as</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">lang</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>get_language_info</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">for</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">"pl"</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>as</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">lang</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>You can then access the information:</p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">Language code:</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{{</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">lang.code</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>}}</b></i></span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">br</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">Name of language:</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{{</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">lang.name_local</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>}}</b></i></span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">br</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">Name in English:</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{{</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">lang.name</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>}}</b></i></span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">br</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">Bi-directional:</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{{</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">lang.bidi</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>}}</b></i></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">Name in the active language:</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{{</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">lang.name_translated</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>}}</b></i></span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><b>get_language_info_list</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>You can also use the {% get_language_info_list %} template tag to retrieve information for a list of lan-</p> <p>guages (e.g. active languages as specified in <a href="index.html#page_1920"><i>LANGUAGES</i></a>). See <a href="index.html#page_683">the section about the set_language redirect view</a> for an example of how to display a language selector using {% get_language_info_list %}.</p> <p>In addition to <a href="index.html#page_1920"><i>LANGUAGES</i></a> style list of tuples, {% get_language_info_list %} supports lists of language codes. If you do this in your view:</p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">context</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">{</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">"available_languages"</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">: [</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">"en"</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">,</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">"es"</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">,</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">"fr"</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">]}</span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>return</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">render(request,</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">"mytemplate.html"</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">, context)</span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>you can iterate over those languages in the template:</p> <p id="page_667" style="text-align:right"><b>Django Documentation, Release 5.2.dev20241127161328</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>get_language_info_list</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">for available_languages</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>as</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">langs</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>for</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">lang</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>in</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">langs</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">...</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>endfor</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><b>Template filters</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>There are also some filters available for convenience:</p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• {{ LANGUAGE_CODE|language_name }} (“German”)</p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• {{ LANGUAGE_CODE|language_name_local }} (“Deutsch”)</p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• {{ LANGUAGE_CODE|language_bidi }} (False)</p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• {{ LANGUAGE_CODE|language_name_translated }} (“německy”, when active language is Czech)</p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><b>Internationalization: in JavaScript code</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>Adding translations to JavaScript poses some problems:</p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• JavaScript code doesn’t have access to a gettext implementation.</p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• JavaScript code doesn’t have access to .po or .mo files; they need to be delivered by the server.</p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• The translation catalogs for JavaScript should be kept as small as possible.</p> <p>Django provides an integrated solution for these problems: It passes the translations into JavaScript, so you can call gettext, etc., from within JavaScript.</p> <p>The main solution to these problems is the following JavaScriptCatalog view, which generates a JavaScript code library with functions that mimic the gettext interface, plus an array of translation strings.</p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><b>The JavaScriptCatalog view</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><b>class JavaScriptCatalog</b></p> <p style="margin-left:2em">A view that produces a JavaScript code library with functions that mimic the gettext interface, plus an array of translation strings.</p> <p style="margin-left:2em">Attributes</p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><b>domain</b></p> <p style="margin-left:4em">Translation domain containing strings to add in the view output. Defaults to 'djangojs'.</p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><b>packages</b></p> <p style="margin-left:4em">A list of <a href="index.html#page_924"><i>application names</i></a> among installed applications. Those apps should contain a locale</p> <p style="margin-left:4em">directory. All those catalogs plus all catalogs found in <a href="index.html#page_1921"><i>LOCALE_PATHS</i></a> (which are always included) are merged into one catalog. Defaults to None, which means that all available translations from</p> <p style="margin-left:4em">all <a href="index.html#page_1917"><i>INSTALLED_APPS</i></a> are provided in the JavaScript output.</p> <p id="page_668"><b>Django Documentation, Release 5.2.dev20241127161328</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p style="margin-left:2em">Example with default values:</p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>from</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">django.views.i18n</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>import</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">JavaScriptCatalog</span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">urlpatterns</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">[</span></p> <p style="margin-left:4em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">path(</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">"jsi18n/"</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">, JavaScriptCatalog</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>.</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">as_view(), name</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">"javascript-catalog"</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">),</span></p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">]</span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p style="margin-left:2em">Example with custom packages:</p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">urlpatterns</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">[</span></p> <p style="margin-left:4em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">path(</span></p> <p style="margin-left:5em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">"jsi18n/myapp/"</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">,</span></p> <p style="margin-left:5em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">JavaScriptCatalog</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>.</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">as_view(packages</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">[</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">"your.app.label"</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">]),</span></p> <p style="margin-left:5em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">name</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">"javascript-catalog"</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">,</span></p> <p style="margin-left:4em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">),</span></p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">]</span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p style="margin-left:2em">If your root URLconf uses <a href="index.html#page_674"><i>i18n_patterns()</i></a>, JavaScriptCatalog must also be wrapped by i18n_patterns() for the catalog to be correctly generated.</p> <p style="margin-left:2em">Example with i18n_patterns():</p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>from</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">django.conf.urls.i18n</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>import</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">i18n_patterns</span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">urlpatterns</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">i18n_patterns(</span></p> <p style="margin-left:4em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">path(</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">"jsi18n/"</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">, JavaScriptCatalog</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>.</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">as_view(), name</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">"javascript-catalog"</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">),</span></p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">)</span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>The precedence of translations is such that the packages appearing later in the packages argument have higher precedence than the ones appearing at the beginning. This is important in the case of clashing trans-lations for the same literal.</p> <p>If you use more than one JavaScriptCatalog view on a site and some of them define the same strings, the strings in the catalog that was loaded last take precedence.</p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><b>Using the JavaScript translation catalog</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>To use the catalog, pull in the dynamically generated script like this:</p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">script</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">src</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">"</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>{%</b></i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>url</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">'javascript-catalog'</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i><b>%}</b></i></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">"</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">></</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">script</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">></span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>This uses reverse URL lookup to find the URL of the JavaScript catalog view. When the catalog is loaded, your JavaScript code can use the following methods:</p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• gettext</p> <p id="page_669" style="text-align:right"><b>Django Documentation, Release 5.2.dev20241127161328</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• ngettext</p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• interpolate</p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• get_format</p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• gettext_noop</p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• pgettext</p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• npgettext</p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• pluralidx</p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><b>gettext</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>The gettext function behaves similarly to the standard gettext interface within your Python code:</p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">document</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>.</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">write(gettext(</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">"this is to be translated"</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">))</span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><b>ngettext</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>The ngettext function provides an interface to pluralize words and phrases:</p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>const</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">objectCount</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">1</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><i>// or 0, or 2, or 3, ...</i></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>const</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">string</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">ngettext(</span></p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">'literal for the singular case'</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">,</span></p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">'literal for the plural case'</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">,</span></p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">objectCount</span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">);</span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><b>interpolate</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>The interpolate function supports dynamically populating a format string. The interpolation syntax is borrowed from Python, so the interpolate function supports both positional and named interpolation:</p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• Positional interpolation: obj contains a JavaScript Array object whose elements values are then se-</p> <p style="margin-left:2em">quentially interpolated in their corresponding fmt placeholders in the same order they appear. For example:</p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>const</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">formats</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">ngettext(</span></p> <p style="margin-left:3em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">'There is %s object. Remaining: %s'</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">,</span></p> <p style="margin-left:3em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">'There are %s objects. Remaining: %s'</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">,</span></p> <p style="margin-left:3em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">11</span></p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">);</span></p> <p style="text-align:right"><span style="font-size:0.8em">(continues on next page)</span></p> <p id="page_670"><b>Django Documentation, Release 5.2.dev20241127161328</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p style="text-align:right"><span style="font-size:0.8em">(continued from previous page)</span></p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>const</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">string</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">interpolate(formats, [</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">11</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">,</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">20</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">]);</span></p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i>// string is 'There are 11 objects. Remaining: 20'</i></span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• Named interpolation: This mode is selected by passing the optional boolean named parameter as true.</p> <p style="margin-left:2em">obj contains a JavaScript object or associative array. For example:</p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>const</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">data</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">{</span></p> <p style="margin-left:3em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">count</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>:</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">10</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">,</span></p> <p style="margin-left:3em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">total</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>:</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">50</span></p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">};</span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>const</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">formats</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">ngettext(</span></p> <p style="margin-left:4em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">'Total: %(total)s, there is %(count)s object'</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">,</span></p> <p style="margin-left:4em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">'there are %(count)s of a total of %(total)s objects'</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">,</span></p> <p style="margin-left:4em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">data.count</span></p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">);</span></p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>const</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">string</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">interpolate(formats, data,</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>true</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">);</span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>You shouldn’t go over the top with string interpolation, though: this is still JavaScript, so the code has to make repeated regular-expression substitutions. This isn’t as fast as string interpolation in Python, so keep it to those cases where you really need it (for example, in conjunction with ngettext to produce proper pluralizations).</p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><b>get_format</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>The get_format function has access to the configured i18n formatting settings and can retrieve the format string for a given setting name:</p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">document</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">.write(get_format(</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">'DATE_FORMAT'</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">));</span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i>// 'N j, Y'</i></span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>It has access to the following settings:</p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• <a href="index.html#page_1906"><i>DATE_FORMAT</i></a></p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• <a href="index.html#page_1906"><i>DATE_INPUT_FORMATS</i></a></p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• <a href="index.html#page_1907"><i>DATETIME_FORMAT</i></a></p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• <a href="index.html#page_1907"><i>DATETIME_INPUT_FORMATS</i></a></p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• <a href="index.html#page_1909"><i>DECIMAL_SEPARATOR</i></a></p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• <a href="index.html#page_1915"><i>FIRST_DAY_OF_WEEK</i></a></p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• <a href="index.html#page_1924"><i>MONTH_DAY_FORMAT</i></a></p> <p id="page_671" style="text-align:right"><b>Django Documentation, Release 5.2.dev20241127161328</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• <a href="index.html#page_1924"><i>NUMBER_GROUPING</i></a></p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• <a href="index.html#page_1930"><i>SHORT_DATE_FORMAT</i></a></p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• <a href="index.html#page_1930"><i>SHORT_DATETIME_FORMAT</i></a></p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• <a href="index.html#page_1934"><i>THOUSAND_SEPARATOR</i></a></p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• <a href="index.html#page_1934"><i>TIME_FORMAT</i></a></p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• <a href="index.html#page_1934"><i>TIME_INPUT_FORMATS</i></a></p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• <a href="index.html#page_1937"><i>YEAR_MONTH_FORMAT</i></a></p> <p>This is useful for maintaining formatting consistency with the Python-rendered values.</p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><b>gettext_noop</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>This emulates the gettext function but does nothing, returning whatever is passed to it:</p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">document</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>.</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">write(gettext_noop(</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">"this will not be translated"</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">))</span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>This is useful for stubbing out portions of the code that will need translation in the future.</p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><b>pgettext</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>The pgettext function behaves like the Python variant (<a href="index.html#page_2089"><i>pgettext()</i></a>), providing a contextually translated word:</p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">document</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>.</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">write(pgettext(</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">"month name"</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">,</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">"May"</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">))</span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><b>npgettext</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>The npgettext function also behaves like the Python variant (<a href="index.html#page_2090"><i>npgettext()</i></a>), providing a pluralized contex-tually translated word:</p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">document</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">.write(npgettext(</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">'group'</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">,</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">'party'</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">,</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">1</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">));</span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i>// party</i></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">document</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">.write(npgettext(</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">'group'</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">,</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">'party'</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">,</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">2</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">));</span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i>// parties</i></span></p> <div style="page-break-after:always"></div> <p id="page_672"><b>Django Documentation, Release 5.2.dev20241127161328</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><b>pluralidx</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>The pluralidx function works in a similar way to the <a href="index.html#page_2018"><i>pluralize</i></a> template filter, determining if a given count should use a plural form of a word or not:</p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">document</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">.write(pluralidx(</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">0</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">));</span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i>// true</i></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">document</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">.write(pluralidx(</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">1</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">));</span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i>// false</i></span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">document</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">.write(pluralidx(</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">2</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">));</span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i>// true</i></span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>In the simplest case, if no custom pluralization is needed, this returns false for the integer 1 and true for all other numbers.</p> <p>However, pluralization is not this simple in all languages. If the language does not support pluralization, an empty value is provided.</p> <p>Additionally, if there are complex rules around pluralization, the catalog view will render a conditional ex-pression. This will evaluate to either a true (should pluralize) or false (should not pluralize) value.</p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><b>The JSONCatalog view</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><b>class JSONCatalog</b></p> <p style="margin-left:2em">In order to use another client-side library to handle translations, you may want to take advantage of</p> <p style="margin-left:2em">the JSONCatalog view. It’s similar to <a href="index.html#page_667"><i>JavaScriptCatalog</i></a> but returns a JSON response.</p> <p style="margin-left:2em">See the documentation for <a href="index.html#page_667"><i>JavaScriptCatalog</i></a> to learn about possible values and use of the domain and packages attributes.</p> <p style="margin-left:2em">The response format is as follows:</p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">{</span></p> <p style="margin-left:4em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">"catalog": {</span></p> <p style="margin-left:5em"><span style="font-size:0.87em"># Translations catalog</span></p> <p style="margin-left:4em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">},</span></p> <p style="margin-left:4em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">"formats": {</span></p> <p style="margin-left:5em"><span style="font-size:0.87em"># Language formats for date, time, etc.</span></p> <p style="margin-left:4em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">},</span></p> <p style="margin-left:4em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">"plural": "..."</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"># Expression for plural forms, or null.</span></p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">}</span></p> <div style="page-break-after:always"></div> <p id="page_673" style="text-align:right"><b>Django Documentation, Release 5.2.dev20241127161328</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><b>Note on performance</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>The various JavaScript/JSON i18n views generate the catalog from .mo files on every request. Since its output is constant, at least for a given version of a site, it’s a good candidate for caching.</p> <p>Server-side caching will reduce CPU load. It’s easily implemented with the <a href="index.html#page_611"><i>cache_page()</i></a> decorator. To trigger cache invalidation when your translations change, provide a version-dependent key prefix, as shown in the example below, or map the view at a version-dependent URL:</p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>from</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">django.views.decorators.cache</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>import</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">cache_page</span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>from</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">django.views.i18n</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>import</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">JavaScriptCatalog</span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><i># The value returned by get_version() must change when translations change.</i></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">urlpatterns</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">[</span></p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">path(</span></p> <p style="margin-left:3em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">"jsi18n/"</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">,</span></p> <p style="margin-left:3em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">cache_page(</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">86400</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">, key_prefix</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">"jsi18n-%s"</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>%</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">get_version())(</span></p> <p style="margin-left:5em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">JavaScriptCatalog</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>.</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">as_view()</span></p> <p style="margin-left:3em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">),</span></p> <p style="margin-left:3em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">name</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">"javascript-catalog"</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">,</span></p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">),</span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">]</span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>Client-side caching will save bandwidth and make your site load faster. <span style="float:right">If you’re using ETags</span></p> <p>(<a href="index.html#page_1593"><i>ConditionalGetMiddleware</i></a>), you’re already covered. Otherwise, you can apply <a href="index.html#page_626">conditional decorators</a>. In the following example, the cache is invalidated whenever you restart your application server:</p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>from</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">django.utils</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>import</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">timezone</span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>from</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">django.views.decorators.http</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>import</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">last_modified</span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>from</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">django.views.i18n</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>import</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">JavaScriptCatalog</span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">last_modified_date</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">timezone</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>.</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">now()</span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">urlpatterns</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">[</span></p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">path(</span></p> <p style="margin-left:3em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">"jsi18n/"</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">,</span></p> <p style="margin-left:3em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">last_modified(</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>lambda</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">req,</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>**</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">kw: last_modified_date)(</span></p> <p style="margin-left:5em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">JavaScriptCatalog</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>.</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">as_view()</span></p> <p style="margin-left:3em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">),</span></p> <p style="margin-left:3em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">name</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">"javascript-catalog"</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">,</span></p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">),</span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em">]</span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>You can even pre-generate the JavaScript catalog as part of your deployment procedure and serve it as a</p> <p>static file. This radical technique is implemented in <a href="https://pypi.org/project/django-statici18n/">django-statici18n.</a></p> <p id="page_674"><b>Django Documentation, Release 5.2.dev20241127161328</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><b>Internationalization: in URL patterns</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p>Django provides two mechanisms to internationalize URL patterns:</p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• Adding the language prefix to the root of the URL patterns to make it possible for <a href="index.html#page_1594"><i>LocaleMiddleware</i></a></p> <p style="margin-left:2em">to detect the language to activate from the requested URL.</p> <p style="text-indent:1em">• Making URL patterns themselves translatable via the <a href="index.html#page_2089"><i>django.utils.translation.gettext_lazy()</i></a></p> <p style="margin-left:2em">function.</p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p style="margin-left:1em">Warning: Using either one of these features requires that an active language be set for each request;</p> <p style="margin-left:1em">in other words, you need to have <a href="index.html#page_1594"><i>django.middleware.locale.LocaleMiddleware</i></a> in your <a href="index.html#page_1923"><i>MIDDLEWARE</i></a></p> <p style="margin-left:1em">setting.</p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><b>Language prefix in URL patterns</b></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><b>i18n_patterns</b>(*urls, prefix_default_language=True)</p> <p>This function can be used in a root URLconf and Django will automatically prepend the current active lan-</p> <p>guage code to all URL patterns defined within <a href="index.html#page_674"><i>i18n_patterns()</i>.</a></p> <p>Setting prefix_default_language to False removes the prefix from the default language (<a href="index.html#page_1918"><i>LANGUAGE_CODE</i></a>). This can be useful when adding translations to existing site so that the current URLs won’t change.</p> <p>Example URL patterns:</p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>from</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">django.conf.urls.i18n</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>import</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">i18n_patterns</span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>from</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">django.urls</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>import</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">include, path</span></p> <p style="text-align:center"> </p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>from</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">about</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>import</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">views</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>as</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">about_views</span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>from</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">news</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>import</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">views</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>as</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">news_views</span></p> <p><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>from</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">sitemap.views</span> <span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">[</span></p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">path(</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">"sitemap.xml"</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">, sitemap, name</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">"sitemap-xml"</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span> <span style="font-size:0.87em">(</span></p> <p style="margin-left:2em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">[</span></p> <p style="margin-left:3em"><span style="font-size:0.87em">path(</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">""</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">, news_views</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>.</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">index, name</span><span style="font-size:0.87em"><b>=</b></span><span style="font-size:0.87em">"index"</span><span style="font-size:0.87em">),</span></p> <p
